title: These 10 candidates for governor made history in the 2026 election
summary: Voters on Tuesday elected the nation's first Black woman governor and the nation's first Native American woman governor.
contentText:
Voters on Tuesday elected the nation's first Black woman governor and the nation's first Native American woman governor.
